name: Hearth
description: A cozy shared space for two people on two PCs. Pair once with a code, then switch between Us, a shared drawing Board and a Pet with the tabs at the top. Needs the Umbra relay, which stores your names, dates, drawings and pet state (deleted 7 days after unpairing or after 30 days unused) and never your location.
author: Yacine-DH
changelog: Us, Board and Pet are now tabs at the top of the widget, so one Hearth does it all. Every picture you save from the Board is also kept in Pictures > Umbra > Hearth (change the folder in Settings > My widgets).

view.label: Opens on
view.hint: Switch any time with the Us, Board and Pet tabs at the top of the widget. Shrink it to a strip if you only want Us. Extra copies of Hearth share one pairing.
